address: Politiebureau Zuid (De Pijp), President Kennedylaan 11, Amsterdam (1995)
notes: 1995 police bureau (Zuid, President Kennedylaan): two-storey cream rendered curved upper volume on a dark brown brick ground floor, white-framed ribbon windows, 27.5 m north front on the President Kennedylaan side (2025-07-14 panorama, w03-5, rectified and thumbnail), west side (2021-04-22, w01-275) with funnel-shaped window boxes on the cream part and an open carport behind gates at the south end. The pand is outside the building-tile extract, so the wall crops were made from the facts.json footprint (scratch variant of all-walls.ts).

Ornaments from the north panorama: POLITIE in blue capitals with the gold flame emblem on the cream band at the right end, above the entrance end of the front (letters MODELLED as wall signage; the kit places wall lettering just above the entrance (right-hand bay, ground storey) while the photo has it one storey higher on the cream band: a position deviation of about 3 m; the flame emblem SKIPPED: a 0.6 m texture-scale decal below the kit's component grain, the letters read at gallery size); recessed glazed entrance with a tall glass slit beside it (entrance MODELLED, the glass slit SKIPPED, one window cut); small blue police plate beside the door (SIMPLIFIED as the kit blue lamp); no striped band, canopy or garage doors on the building (the carport is an open gated bay, SKIPPED: not a wall component, its 3DBAG outline is already a recess); funnel window boxes on the west cream part (SKIPPED: 0.6 m angled reveals, simplified to flush ribbon openings).

The cream colour is the majority of the wall area (two upper storeys); the dark brick ground floor is simplified to the same colour (one palette per wall group; a per-storey colour split is not available), so the dark/cream contrast of the photo is lost. East and south walls: 2017 panorama is 32 % washed out and oblique (24 deg), left to otherWalls (blank).
